<subagent sessionID="ses_e49dd247cffewCGjLE2Wk80ln6" state="completed" description="Audit localization strings">
## Recommended priorities

1. **Core, frequently seen UI** — HUD labels, menus, help, game-over text, and common toasts. These appear throughout a play session and are good first targets in `src/main.js`, especially `updateHUD()`, `showHelp()`, `gameOver()`, and toast call sites.
2. **Ability names and descriptions** — These are prominent in ability-selection and upgrade screens. Cover the records in `src/data/abilities/low.js` and `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, plus strings created by `makeHighAbility()` in `src/main.js`.
3. **Dialogue and progression text** — Localize `startDialogue()`, `beginAwakening()`, and other progression prompts after the core UI and abilities.

## Safe integration approach

`src/main.js` already imports `language`, `setLanguage`, and `t` from `src/i18n.js`, but the visible strings are mostly rendered directly. Use the existing translation helper at **render time** for UI text, rather than replacing gameplay data or mechanics.

For abilities, keep stable IDs and gameplay fields unchanged; translate only display names, descriptions, passive text, and evolution text. This avoids changing save data or game logic. For strings assembled dynamically, use translation keys with parameters or compose translated fragments instead of translating the final English string.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, with Indonesian as the default language and an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate all visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including UI, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and victory/defeat messages.
- Use a mysterious, firm, formal voice for system messages; leave no English text in the default interface.
- Add settings options **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; default to Indonesian and persist the selection.
- Use **EPIS** for Epic. Keep text legible in the pixel font and avoid clipping.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser-based implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated because there is no dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment bugs; `node --check src/main.js` passed.
- Improved touch-device detection and added a touch USE button; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls show, joystick responds, and nearby NPC dialogue opens.
- Browser-tested desktop flows: character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title.
- Created `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations, vocabulary mappings, and language preference storage helpers (`t()`/`setLanguage()`); imported helpers into `src/main.js`.

### Active
- Integrate localization across `src/main.js`, `index.html`, and visible game data, including generated abilities, system content, HUD, dialogue, and messages.
- Add the persistent language selector with **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**.
- Test Indonesian coverage, English switching and persistence, text fit, syntax, and gameplay flows including progression, bosses, loot, and NPC interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Localize dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated and data-driven ability text, menus, messages, HUD, quests, and dialogue.
2. Update `index.html` static visible text and document language; add the settings language selector and wire it to `setLanguage()`.
3. Run syntax checks and browser tests for language switching, persistence, coverage, layouts, and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; integration and completeness remain pending.
- `src/main.js`: Core game systems and most visible dynamic text; imports i18n helpers, not yet integrated.
- `index.html`: Screens, menus, HUD, settings, and touch controls; currently largely English.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation, pixel font, and responsive layouts.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status`; preserve existing work.
- Local test server: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `t()` translates exact dictionary entries and selected vocabulary terms; unknown text passes through unchanged, so comprehensive coverage still needs implementation and verification.
- Current `index.html` has `lang="en"` and visible English static text; current `src/main.js` uses English strings throughout dynamic rendering.
- Settings are rendered in `renderSystem('settings')` in `src/main.js`; current settings HTML has save/title actions and controls text but no language selector.
- A background audit completed and recommended prioritizing core UI/toasts, abilities, then dialogue/progression; render-time translation avoids affecting gameplay logic.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, with Indonesian as the default language and an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate all visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including UI, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and victory/defeat messages.
- Use a mysterious, firm, formal voice for system messages; leave no English text in the default interface.
- Add settings options **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; default to Indonesian and persist the selection.
- Use **EPIS** for Epic. Keep text legible in the pixel font and avoid clipping.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser-based implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated because there is no dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment bugs; `node --check src/main.js` passed.
- Improved touch-device detection and added a touch USE button; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls show, joystick responds, and nearby NPC dialogue opens.
- Browser-tested desktop flows: character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title.
- Created `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations, vocabulary mappings, and language preference storage helpers (`t()`/`setLanguage()`); imported helpers into `src/main.js`.

### Active
- Integrate localization across `src/main.js`, `index.html`, and visible game data, including generated abilities, system content, HUD, dialogue, and messages.
- Add the persistent language selector with **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**.
- Test Indonesian coverage, English switching and persistence, text fit, syntax, and gameplay flows including progression, bosses, loot, and NPC interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Localize dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated and data-driven ability text, menus, messages, HUD, quests, and dialogue.
2. Update `index.html` static visible text and document language; add the settings language selector and wire it to `setLanguage()`.
3. Run syntax checks and browser tests for language switching, persistence, coverage, layouts, and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; integration and completeness remain pending.
- `src/main.js`: Core game systems and most visible dynamic text; imports i18n helpers, not yet integrated.
- `index.html`: Screens, menus, HUD, settings, and touch controls; currently largely English.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation, pixel font, and responsive layouts.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status`; preserve existing work.
- Local test server: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `t()` translates exact dictionary entries and selected vocabulary terms; unknown text passes through unchanged, so comprehensive coverage still needs implementation and verification.
- Current `index.html` has `lang="en"` and visible English static text; current `src/main.js` uses English strings throughout dynamic rendering.
- Settings are rendered in `renderSystem('settings')` in `src/main.js`; current settings HTML has save/title actions and controls text but no language selector.
- A background audit recommended prioritizing core UI/toasts, abilities, then dialogue/progression; render-time translation avoids affecting gameplay logic.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, with Indonesian as the default language and an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate all visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including UI, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and victory/defeat messages.
- Use a mysterious, firm, formal voice for system messages; leave no English text in the default interface.
- Add settings options **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; default to Indonesian and persist the selection.
- Use **EPIS** for Epic. Keep text legible in the pixel font and avoid clipping.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser-based implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated because there is no dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment bugs; `node --check src/main.js` passed.
- Improved touch-device detection and added a touch USE button; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls show, joystick responds, and nearby NPC dialogue opens.
- Browser-tested desktop flows: character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title.
- Created `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations, vocabulary mappings, and language preference storage helpers (`t()`/`setLanguage()`); imported helpers into `src/main.js`.

### Active
- Integrate localization across `src/main.js`, `index.html`, and visible game data, including generated abilities, system content, HUD, dialogue, and messages.
- Add the persistent language selector with **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**.
- Test Indonesian coverage, English switching and persistence, text fit, syntax, and gameplay flows including progression, bosses, loot, and NPC interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Localize dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated and data-driven ability text, menus, messages, HUD, quests, and dialogue.
2. Update `index.html` static visible text and document language; add the settings language selector and wire it to `setLanguage()`.
3. Run syntax checks and browser tests for language switching, persistence, coverage, layouts, and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; integration and completeness remain pending.
- `src/main.js`: Core game systems and most visible dynamic text; imports i18n helpers, not yet integrated.
- `index.html`: Screens, menus, HUD, settings, and touch controls; currently largely English.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation, pixel font, and responsive layouts.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status`; preserve existing work.
- Local test server: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `t()` translates exact dictionary entries and selected vocabulary terms; unknown text passes through unchanged, so comprehensive coverage still needs implementation and verification.
- Current `index.html` has `lang="en"` and visible English static text; current `src/main.js` uses English strings throughout dynamic rendering.
- Settings are rendered in `renderSystem('settings')` in `src/main.js`; current settings HTML has save/title actions and controls text but no language selector.
- A background audit recommended prioritizing core UI/toasts, abilities, then dialogue/progression; render-time translation avoids affecting gameplay logic.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate all visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; use **EPIS** for Epic; ensure text is legible and not clipped.
- Add language options **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; `node --check src/main.js` had passed before the latest edits.
- Improved touch detection and added a touch USE button; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations, vocabulary mappings, and language preference storage helpers (`t()`/`setLanguage()`).
- Changed `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector to the settings view in `src/main.js`, with a change handler that saves the game, persists the language via `setLanguage()`, and reloads.
- Added `localizeStatic()` to translate matching static DOM text and attributes on boot.

### Active
- Integrate localization comprehensively across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated/data-driven ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, and messages.
- Translate remaining static HTML text and refine translation coverage/voice.
- Verify language switching and persistence, default Indonesian coverage, text fit, syntax, and gameplay progression/boss/loot/NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks after the latest localization edits and resolve any errors.
2. Review/extend `src/i18n.js`; `t()` currently leaves unknown text unchanged, so many ability descriptions and dynamic strings may still be English.
3. Translate dynamic render paths and ensure changing language updates all displayed content, not only boot-time static content and settings.
4. Test language selector persistence, Indonesian/English rendering, layouts, and core gameplay in a browser.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, settings selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Repository files are uncommitted and appear untracked in `git status`; preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Recent edits added the settings selector and boot-time static localization, but no syntax/browser verification has been run since those edits.
- `localizeStatic()` translates only exact dictionary matches and matching attributes; it does not cover all dynamic content or guarantee full Indonesian localization.
- The latest edit to `src/i18n.js` appended many entries to an already dense dictionary line; inspect and validate before continuing.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; use **EPIS** for Epic; ensure text is legible and not clipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; changed `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, and messages.
- Review and extend `src/i18n.js`; ensure Indonesian system voice, EPIS terminology, and comprehensive translation coverage.
- Translate remaining static HTML and verify language switching/persistence, text fit, syntax, and gameplay progression, boss/loot/NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks after the latest localization edits and resolve any errors.
2. Inspect `src/i18n.js` for validity and coverage; its translation dictionary is dense and `t()` leaves unknown strings unchanged.
3. Translate remaining dynamic and static visible content; verify language changes update all displayed content.
4. Test language persistence, Indonesian and English rendering, layout/text fit, and core gameplay progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, settings selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Files are uncommitted and appear untracked in `git status`; preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- The recent localization edits have not had syntax or browser verification; the attempted event-handler edit initially failed to match, then a second targeted edit succeeded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; use **EPIS** for Epic; ensure text is legible and not clipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; changed `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`; both passed.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, and messages.
- Review and extend `src/i18n.js`; ensure Indonesian system voice, EPIS terminology, and comprehensive translation coverage.
- Translate remaining static HTML and verify language switching/persistence, text fit, and gameplay progression, boss/loot/NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/i18n.js` for validity and coverage; `t()` currently leaves unknown strings unchanged.
2. Translate remaining dynamic and static visible content without changing gameplay data or mechanics.
3. Test Indonesian and English rendering, language persistence, text fit, and core progression through boss, loot, and NPC flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, settings selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status` showed files as untracked. Preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- The translations are applied at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; use **EPIS** for Epic; ensure text is legible and not clipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; changed `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`; both passed.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, and messages.
- Review and extend `src/i18n.js`; `t()` currently leaves unknown strings unchanged. Ensure Indonesian system voice, EPIS terminology, and comprehensive translation coverage.
- Translate remaining static HTML and verify language switching/persistence, text fit, and gameplay progression, including boss, loot, and NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and extend `src/i18n.js` coverage, especially dynamic and generated text.
2. Localize remaining static HTML and dynamic visible content without changing gameplay data or mechanics.
3. Test Indonesian and English rendering, language persistence, text fit, and core progression through boss, loot, and NPC flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, settings selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status` showed files as untracked. Preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Translations are applied at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; use **EPIS** for Epic; ensure text is legible and not clipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; changed `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`; both passed.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, and messages.
- Review and extend `src/i18n.js`; `t()` currently leaves unknown strings unchanged. Ensure Indonesian system voice, EPIS terminology, and comprehensive translation coverage.
- Translate remaining static HTML and verify language switching/persistence, text fit, and gameplay progression, including boss, loot, and NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and extend `src/i18n.js` coverage, especially dynamic and generated text.
2. Localize remaining static HTML and dynamic visible content without changing gameplay data or mechanics.
3. Test Indonesian and English rendering, language persistence, text fit, and core progression through boss, loot, and NPC flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, settings selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status` showed files as untracked. Preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Translations are applied at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Translate visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; use **EPIS** for Epic; ensure text is legible and not clipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; changed `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`; both passed.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, and messages.
- Review and extend `src/i18n.js`; `t()` currently leaves unknown strings unchanged. Ensure Indonesian system voice, EPIS terminology, and comprehensive translation coverage.
- Translate remaining static HTML and verify language switching/persistence, text fit, and gameplay progression, including boss, loot, and NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and extend `src/i18n.js` coverage, especially dynamic and generated text.
2. Localize remaining static HTML and dynamic visible content without changing gameplay data or mechanics.
3. Test Indonesian and English rendering, language persistence, text fit, and core progression through boss, loot, and NPC flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, settings selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and Epic ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status` showed files as untracked. Preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Translations are applied at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; set `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Inspected dynamic UI rendering and confirmed `t()` translates exact matches and rarity terms but returns other unknown strings unchanged.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, toasts, and messages.
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage, particularly dynamic and generated text; preserve the formal, mysterious System voice and EPIS terminology.
- Translate remaining static HTML and test language switching/persistence, text fit, and gameplay progression including boss, loot, and NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `src/i18n.js` to cover dynamically generated ability and gameplay text, then apply `t()` consistently to dynamically rendered strings in `src/main.js`.
2. Translate remaining static HTML and ensure interpolated strings, labels, attributes, and generated descriptions display in Indonesian.
3. Test both languages, persistence after reload, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, language selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status --short` showed project files as untracked. Preserve existing work.
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Dynamic rendering includes template strings for quests, skill descriptions, stats, settings, dialogues, toasts, and generated abilities; exact-match `t()` alone does not translate unknown composite strings.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default, including interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; set `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Inspected dynamic UI rendering and confirmed `t()` translates exact matches and rarity terms but returns other unknown strings unchanged.
- Confirmed project changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.

### Active
- Integrate Indonesian localization across dynamic content in `src/main.js`, including generated ability descriptions, system content, HUD, quests, dialogue, toasts, and messages.
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage, particularly dynamic and generated text; preserve the formal, mysterious System voice and EPIS terminology.
- Translate remaining static HTML and test language switching/persistence, text fit, and gameplay progression including boss, loot, and NPC flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `src/i18n.js` for dynamic and generated gameplay text, then apply `t()` consistently to dynamically rendered strings in `src/main.js`.
2. Translate remaining static HTML and ensure interpolated strings, labels, attributes, and generated descriptions display in Indonesian.
3. Test both languages, persistence after reload, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, dynamic visible strings, language selector, localization setup, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Static UI text and document language; still largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- The local test server URL is `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Dynamic rendering includes template strings for quests, skill descriptions, stats, settings, dialogues, toasts, and generated abilities; exact-match `t()` alone does not translate unknown composite strings.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; set `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Confirmed translation helper `t()` is currently used only in a few render paths; exact-match translation and rarity terms do not cover most interpolated or generated text.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were reported as untracked.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for dynamic/generated content and ability descriptions.
- Apply translations consistently to dynamic UI in `src/main.js` and remaining static HTML in `index.html`.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence after reload, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Translate dynamic and generated content, including ability descriptions and interpolated quest/status strings.
2. Apply translations to dynamic rendering and remaining static HTML while preserving gameplay data.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, legibility, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic and dynamic UI rendering, including quests, HUD, dialogue, abilities, achievements, and system screens.
- `index.html`: Static UI text remains largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; interpolated template text is not translated by exact-match `t()`.
- `renderSystem()` contains many hard-coded labels; `beginAwakening()` renders ability names, descriptions, passive text, and skills directly.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; set `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Confirmed most dynamic strings remain untranslated; reviewed `src/main.js` dynamic UI render paths and ability data in `src/data/abilities/low.js`.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for dynamic/generated content and ability descriptions.
- Apply translations consistently to dynamic UI in `src/main.js` and remaining static HTML in `index.html`.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence after reload, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Translate dynamic and generated content, including ability descriptions and interpolated quest/status strings.
2. Apply translations to dynamic rendering and remaining static HTML while preserving gameplay data.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, legibility, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic and dynamic UI rendering, including quests, HUD, dialogue, abilities, achievements, and system screens.
- `index.html`: Static UI text remains largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; interpolated template text is not translated by exact-match `t()`.
- `renderSystem()` contains many hard-coded labels; `beginAwakening()` renders ability names, descriptions, passive text, and skills directly.
- Work is uncommitted; project files are untracked.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; set `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Reviewed dynamic UI render paths and ability data; confirmed substantial dynamic content remains untranslated.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for dynamic/generated content and ability descriptions.
- Apply translations consistently to dynamic UI in `src/main.js` and remaining static HTML in `index.html`.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence after reload, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Translate dynamic and generated content, including ability descriptions and interpolated quest/status strings.
2. Apply translations to dynamic rendering and remaining static HTML while preserving gameplay data.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, legibility, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic and dynamic UI rendering, including quests, HUD, dialogue, abilities, achievements, and system screens.
- `index.html`: Static UI text remains largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; interpolated template text is not translated by exact-match `t()`.
- `renderSystem()` contains many hard-coded labels; `beginAwakening()` renders ability names, descriptions, passive text, and skills directly.
- Work is uncommitted; project files are untracked.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows including character creation, awakening, world entry, save/load, system menu, dungeon entry, combat inputs, and return to title; mobile Chrome emulation confirmed controls, joystick movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` with Indonesian translations and language preference helpers; set `index.html` document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, a change handler that saves progress and persists the selection before reloading, and boot-time `localizeStatic()` for exact-match text and attributes.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Reviewed dynamic UI render paths and ability data; confirmed substantial dynamic content remains untranslated.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for dynamic/generated content and ability descriptions.
- Apply translations consistently to dynamic UI in `src/main.js` and remaining static HTML in `index.html`.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Translate dynamic and generated content, including ability descriptions and interpolated quest/status strings.
2. Apply translations to dynamic rendering and remaining static HTML while preserving gameplay data.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, legibility, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic and dynamic UI rendering, including quests, HUD, dialogue, abilities, achievements, and system screens.
- `index.html`: Static UI text remains largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; interpolated template text is not translated by exact-match `t()`.
- `renderSystem()` contains many hard-coded labels; `beginAwakening()` renders ability names, descriptions, passive text, and skills directly.
- Work is uncommitted; project files are untracked.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translations and language preference helpers; set document language to `id`.
- Added a language selector in settings, persistence/reload handler, and boot-time exact-match localization.
- Verified `src/main.js` and `src/i18n.js` syntax before the latest edits.
- Updated dynamic ability awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, and portions of `renderSystem()` to call `t()` for ability descriptions, passive text, skills, stats, evolution, inventory items, and rarity.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for dynamic/generated content, ability names and descriptions, and interpolated quest/status strings.
- Apply translations consistently to remaining dynamic UI and static HTML.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks after the recent `src/main.js` edits and fix any issues.
2. Continue translating dynamic/generated content and remaining `renderSystem()` content, including interpolation and localized names.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, legibility, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic and dynamic UI rendering; recent edits localize select render paths, while many strings remain.
- `index.html`: Static UI text remains largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; exact-match `t()` does not localize interpolated phrases unless explicitly handled.
- `beginAwakening()` and parts of `renderSystem()` now pass ability data through `t()`; check translation coverage before expanding further.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, system messages, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Updated awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, and portions of `renderSystem()` to translate ability names/descriptions/passives, stats, evolution, inventory items, and rarity.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for generated/dynamic content, ability names and descriptions, and interpolated quest/status strings.
- Apply translations consistently to remaining dynamic UI and static HTML.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks after the latest `src/main.js` edits and fix any issues.
2. Continue translating dynamic/generated content and remaining `renderSystem()` and static HTML, including interpolated phrases and localized names.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, legibility, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; dynamic translation coverage is incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Game logic and dynamic UI rendering; recent edits localize select render paths, while many strings remain.
- `index.html`: Static UI text remains largely English.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; exact-match `t()` does not localize interpolated phrases unless explicitly handled.
- `beginAwakening()` and parts of `renderSystem()` now pass ability data through `t()`; check translation coverage before expanding further.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated without a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, and portions of `renderSystem()`, including ability names/descriptions/passives, stats, evolution, inventory items, and rarity.
- Ran `node --check src/main.js && node --check src/i18n.js` successfully.

### Active
- Extend `src/i18n.js` coverage for generated/dynamic content, ability names and descriptions, and interpolated quest/status strings.
- Apply translations consistently to remaining dynamic UI and static HTML; `renderSystem()` still contains many hardcoded English strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, preference persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Translate remaining `renderSystem()` strings and dynamic/interpolated UI phrases, including quest/status text.
2. Expand `src/i18n.js` coverage for generated ability content and localize remaining static HTML.
3. Re-run syntax checks and test both languages, persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text, much of which still needs localization.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; exact-match `t()` does not localize interpolated phrases unless explicitly handled.
- Recent edits in `beginAwakening()` and parts of `renderSystem()` already pass content through `t()`; check coverage before expanding further.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, and portions of `renderSystem()`, including ability names/descriptions/passives, stats, evolution, inventory items, and rarity.

### Active
- Extend localization to dynamic/generated ability names and descriptions, interpolated quest/status strings, and remaining `renderSystem()` content.
- Localize remaining static HTML and dynamic UI text consistently.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Localize remaining `renderSystem()` content, including skills, equipment, quest, dungeon, bestiary, achievements, map, and settings.
2. Expand `src/i18n.js` coverage for generated ability content and interpolated quest/status, HUD, dialogue, toast, and modal strings; localize remaining static HTML.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text, much of which still needs localization.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; exact-match `t()` does not localize interpolated phrases unless explicitly handled.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover their ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- The latest inspection identified untranslated strings across `renderSystem()` and dynamic UI; no code changes were made in that turn.
- Project files are untracked in git; no `package.json` is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, and enemy/boss defeat labels.
- Wrapped system-tab content for skills/evolution, inventory, equipment, quest, dungeon, bestiary, achievements, and map in translation calls; localized status defeat labels.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, interpolated strings, HUD, dialogue, toast, modal strings, and remaining static/dynamic interface text.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translation entries for wrapped system-tab strings and inspect the dictionary for missing labels.
2. Localize remaining dynamic and static interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Current `git status --short` showed project files as untracked; changes are uncommitted.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- Recent inspection confirmed high-rarity strings are passed through `t()` in some render paths, while many generated low/mid ability strings and dynamic HUD, quest, toast, and modal text still need coverage.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

Whenever you dodge, a phantom echo strikes your attacker.

soul:
Soul Absorption
Nothing truly ends. It only changes owner.
When living things die near you, something thin and bright leaks upward. You have learned to drink it.
+6% Lifesteal. Killing enemies restores 8 Mana. +10% XP gained.
Soul Drain
Anchor a tether of soul-light to an enemy, damaging and healing over 3s.
Soul Nova
Release gathered souls in a ring. Heal for each enemy struck.
Harvest
Reap enemies below 30% HP. Each kill grants a soul charge of power.
Thin Veil
Soul Drain heals +20% more. Soul Nova gains +20% radius.
Hollow Feast
Each enemy killed grants a stacking +3% damage buff for 10s (max 10).

gravity:
Gravity Manipulation
The earth is only a suggestion of weight.
Dust rises around you. Rain hesitates. The world leans in when you ask it to.
+12% Attack. Enemies you strike are pulled slightly toward you. +8% Defense.
Gravity Well
Crush a point in space, pulling enemies in and slowing them.
Singularity
Collapse gravity at the target point. Heavy damage, brief stun.
Levitate
Defy the ground for 6s: +25% speed, +30% defense, and immunity to knockback.
Dense Star
Gravity Well radius +25%. Your slams knock enemies down for 0.6s.
Event Horizon
Singularity damage +40% and leaves a lingering gravity scar.

necro:
Necromancy
Death is a door that only opens one way. Unless you cheat.
The dead whisper in a language older than graves. They offer to work for you, briefly.
Summons gain +40% damage. Killing an enemy has a 25% chance to raise a brief skeleton.
Raise Dead
Call a skeleton warrior from the ground to fight for 12s.
Corpse Burst
Detonate a corpse-like bloom of necrotic force at the target area.
Death Coil
Fire a screaming skull that damages enemies and heals you.
Bone Choir
Raise Dead summons two skeletons. Minions gain +20% HP.
Lord of the Quiet
Your summons explode into bone shards when they die.

time:
Time Perception
The present is a narrow room. You have found the door.
Between one heartbeat and the next, you live an extra second. Nobody else notices.
+12% Cooldown Recovery. +10% Attack Speed. +10% Dodge.
Temporal Bubble
Slow time in an area for 5s. Enemies inside move and attack sluggishly.
Haste
Accelerate your own timeline for 7s: +30% attack speed, +20% speed.
Rewind
Pull your body back to where it was three seconds ago and heal.
Long Second
Temporal Bubble slows enemies 10% more and lasts 1s longer.
Closed Loop
Rewind heals 50% more and grants 1s of invulnerability.

dragon:
Dragon Transformation
There is a furnace under your ribs. It has always been there.
Scales itch beneath your skin. Your shadow stretches wings you do not yet have.
+10% Max HP. +12% Attack. Taking damage builds Dragon Fury, boosting damage.
Dragon Breath
Exhale a cone of searing flame that burns everything in front of you.
Wing Gale
Beat spectral wings, dashing forward and blasting enemies aside.
Draconic Form
Let the dragon surface for 10s: +40% attack, +20% HP, +15% speed.
Scalebound
+12% Defense. Dragon Breath reaches 20% farther.
Sky Tyrant
Draconic Form also grants flight-like speed and a burning aura.
