messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, enemy/boss defeat labels, and system-tab content.
- Added several missing interface translations and dynamic patterns to `src/i18n.js` (quest counts, entered/equipped messages, level-up/evolution notices, and day labels).
- Updated `toast()` in `src/main.js` to translate messages through `t()`.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, ability data, interpolated strings, HUD, dialogue, modal strings, and remaining static/dynamic interface text.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translation entries for ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings; inspect coverage for missing labels.
2. Localize remaining dynamic and static interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Current `git status --short` previously showed project files as untracked; changes are uncommitted.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, enemy/boss defeat labels, and system-tab content.
- Added translations and patterns for quest counts, entered/equipped messages, level-up/evolution notices, day labels, and additional UI/system text.
- Updated `toast()` in `src/main.js` to translate messages through `t()`.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, ability data, remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings, and other visible text in `src/main.js`, `index.html`, and ability data.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; prior `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; rerunning with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs showed untranslated ability data, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, enemy/boss defeat labels, system-tab content, and multiple quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, and day messages.
- Updated `toast()` in `src/main.js` to translate messages through `t()`.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, ability data, remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings, and other visible text in `src/main.js`, `index.html`, and ability data.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; prior `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; rerunning with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs showed untranslated ability data, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, enemy/boss defeat labels, system-tab content, and multiple quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, and day messages.
- Updated `toast()` in `src/main.js` to translate messages through `t()`.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, ability data, remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings, and other visible text in `src/main.js`, `index.html`, and ability data.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; prior `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; rerunning with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs showed untranslated ability data, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, enemy/boss defeat labels, system-tab content, and multiple quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, and day messages.
- Updated `toast()` in `src/main.js` to translate messages through `t()`.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, ability data, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; prior `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; rerunning with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs showed untranslated ability data, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized awakening reveal, skill bar, mini-level label, portions of `renderSystem()`, enemy/boss defeat labels, system-tab content, and multiple quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, and day messages.
- Updated `toast()` in `src/main.js` to translate messages through `t()`.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for generated abilities, ability data, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; prior `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; rerunning with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs showed untranslated ability data, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the last `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the last `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Give system messages a mysterious, firm, formal voice; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the last `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining wrapped system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax checks and test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the last `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No syntax checks or browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- Ran `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` successfully after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` pass after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` pass after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability data, generated high-rarity abilities, and remaining HUD/dialogue/modal strings.
- Test Indonesian and English selection, persistence, legibility, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for untranslated ability data and remaining system-tab strings.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface content in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and core progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; many visible strings remain English, including generated high-rarity abilities.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes, but dynamic labels need attention.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to localize at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Generated high-rarity ability models are in `src/main.js` (`highModels`, `makeHighAbility()`); translations must cover ability names, skills, passives, and evolution text.
- A Node translation-coverage check initially failed because `localStorage` was undefined; with `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs, untranslated ability data remained, including entries for `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after latest localization edits.
- Confirmed the language selector saves the preference through `setLanguage()` and reloads the page.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for all common-to-Epic ability names, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions; a coverage check found many untranslated entries, including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Translate generated high-rarity ability data and remaining dynamic/static interface text.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations and generated high-rarity ability translations in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface strings in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including untranslated rarity and ability labels.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks, then browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and game logic; generated high-rarity abilities and many runtime strings.
- `index.html`: Static interface text; boot-time localization handles matching text nodes.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text to translate at render time.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text to translate at render time.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- The ability-coverage check used `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs; it reported extensive untranslated content across `LOW_ABILITIES` and `MID_ABILITIES`.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.
- Confirmed the language selector saves the preference through `setLanguage()` and reloads the page.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for common-to-EPIS ability names, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions; coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Translate generated high-rarity abilities and remaining dynamic/static interface text, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations and generated high-rarity ability translations in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface strings in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks, then browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- The ability-coverage check used `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs and found numerous untranslated ability strings.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions, including generated high-rarity abilities; current coverage checks show untranslated entries such as `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data and generated high-rarity ability translations in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining interface strings in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks, then browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Ability-coverage checks used `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs and found numerous untranslated ability strings.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions, including generated high-rarity abilities; coverage checks show untranslated entries such as `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data and generated high-rarity ability translations in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining interface strings in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks, then browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appeared untracked in the latest `git status --short`.
- `src/main.js` is highly compressed; granular exact-match edits to `renderSystem()` succeeded after a larger bulk edit failed with `Could not find oldString in src/main.js`.
- Ability-coverage checks used `globalThis.localStorage` and `globalThis.document` stubs and found numerous untranslated ability strings.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity ability names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity ability names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations already include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.
