messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- No browser tests have been run after the latest localization edits.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- Existing `src/i18n.js` translations include high-rarity models Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is still required.
- Recent inspection confirmed `src/main.js` imports `language`, `setLanguage`, and `t` from `src/i18n.js`; `toast(msg)` translates via `t(msg)`. No additional code changes or tests occurred in the latest exchange.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is required.
- Recent inspection found dynamic text still needing translation: `updatePreview()` constructs `PATH OF THE ...`; `beginAwakening()` uses raw rarity names; HUD title uses the raw ability name; and `createMap()` assigns quest text. `index.html` also contains static labels and accessibility text that need coverage.
- No code changes or tests occurred in the most recent exchange.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is required.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`. `index.html` also has static labels and accessibility text needing coverage.
- Recent inspection only; no code changes or tests occurred in the most recent exchange.

## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is required.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`. `index.html` also has static labels and accessibility text needing coverage.
- Recent inspection only; no code changes or tests occurred in the most recent exchange.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and boot-time localization.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills; further ability and UI coverage is required.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`. `index.html` also has static labels and accessibility text needing coverage.
- Recent inspection only; no code changes or tests occurred in the most recent exchange.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `src/main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `src/main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `src/main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.

strength Enhanced Strength The body remembers what the world forgot. Your muscles knit with a density that should tear flesh. Every blow lands with the weight of falling stone. +12% Attack Power. +6% Defense. Heavy attacks stagger lesser foes. Titan's Sinew|+10% Attack. Shockwaves knock enemies back further.;Worldbreaker|+15% Attack. Ground slams gain +25% radius. Titan Fist|Slam both fists down, sending a shockwave through nearby enemies.;Iron Will|Harden your body for 8s: +30% defense, +20% attack, and reduced stagger.;Colossus Slam|Mark a target area and bring down a devastating pillar of force.
regen Minor Regeneration Flesh is a temporary argument. Wounds close with green threads of living light. Pain becomes a distant suggestion. Regenerate 1.8 HP per second. Healing received +15%. Verdant Blood|Regenerate 2.5 HP/s. Heal zones follow you.;Undying Spring|Regenerate 4 HP/s. Fall below 20% HP to burst-heal once per minute. Mend|Weave living light through your wounds, restoring 30% max HP over 3s.;Verdant Aura|Create a healing grove for 6s that restores allies and burns enemies inside.;Second Bloom|A protective bloom shields you and accelerates regeneration for 7s.
nightvision Night Vision Darkness is only a room you have not entered. The dark peels back into silver contours. Hidden things glow. Weak points become constellations. +8 Perception. +12% Critical Chance at night. Vision radius greatly increased. Silver Eyes|Critical strikes blind enemies for 1s. +5% Critical Chance.;Umbral Truth|Enemies below 30% HP are outlined and take +12% damage from you. Piercing Gaze|Reveal all enemies in a wide radius and mark their weak points for 7s.;Umbral Bolt|Fire a spear of condensed darkness that pierces up to 3 enemies.;Phantom Sight|For 6s, see through space: +25% dodge and attacks cannot miss.
windstep Wind Step The air agrees to carry you. Your feet barely trouble the ground. Wind folds around your ankles and urges you forward. +10% Movement Speed. +6% Dodge. Dash stamina cost reduced. Gale Walker|+8% Movement Speed. Dashes leave a cutting wake.;Eye of the Storm|+10% Dodge. Dodging releases a small wind burst. Gale Dash|Rush forward as a blade of wind, cutting enemies in your path.;Wind Blade|Launch a crescent of compressed air that pierces and knocks back.;Zephyr Stance|Become one with the wind for 6s: +30% speed, +20% dodge, +15% attack speed.
flame Flame Manipulation Everything wants to burn. You merely remind it. Heat gathers in your palms like a faithful animal. The air above your knuckles begins to shimmer. +10% Attack. Attacks apply 2s Burn for 18% of damage dealt. Ember Ascendant|Burn damage +50%. Cinder Wall lasts 2s longer.;Cinder Sovereign|Fire skills detonate burning enemies for bonus area damage. Ember Bolt|Hurl a compressed fireball that explodes on impact.;Cinder Wall|Raise a wall of flame at the target line for 6s, burning anything that crosses.;Meteor|Call a burning stone from the sky. Delayed, massive, and very loud.
ice Ice Spear Stillness, sharpened. Frost writes its geometry along your bones. You can hear water waiting inside every living thing. +8% Defense. Your attacks Slow enemies by 15% for 2s. Winter's Claim|Slow effects last 1s longer. +10% damage against slowed enemies.;Absolute Zero|Frozen enemies take +25% Critical Damage. Glacial Nova may freeze. Frost Lance|Launch a piercing spear of ice that slows everything it touches.;Glacial Nova|Detonate a ring of frost around you, slowing and damaging nearby enemies.;Ice Armor|Coat yourself in living ice for 8s: absorb damage and reflect a portion.
shadowmove Shadow Movement Every shadow is a door you forgot. Your silhouette lags a heartbeat behind you. When you step into shade, the world loses track of where you are. +12% Movement Speed while in shade or at night. +8% Dodge. Umbral Door|Shadowstep cooldown reduced by 20%. Leaving stealth blinds nearby enemies.;Living Darkness|Summons gain +30% damage and last 2s longer. Shadowstep|Step through the dark to the target point, leaving a lash of shadow behind.;Nightfall Clone|Tear off a shadow decoy that fights for 8s and explodes when destroyed.;Eclipse Burst|Release a wave of blind terror, damaging and fearing enemies.
lightning Lightning Touch A thought, arriving too fast. Static clings to your teeth. Your nerves hum at a frequency the world was not built to carry. +12% Cooldown Recovery. +1 Mana per second. Critical hits chain a spark. Conductor|Chain Lightning jumps to +1 target. +10% Critical Chance.;Stormheart|Lightning skills stun for 0.5s. +15% Cooldown Recovery. Arc Chain|Unleash lightning that leaps between up to 5 enemies, growing weaker each jump.;Static Field|Charge an area for 6s. Enemies inside are slowed and repeatedly shocked.;Thunderclap|Blink to a target enemy and detonate a thunderclap around them.
blood Blood Control Your body is a kingdom. Blood is its only citizen. The pulse beneath your skin becomes audible, then obedient. Wounds open where you point. +8% Lifesteal. Bleeding enemies take +10% damage from you. Max HP +8%. Crimson Covenant|Lifesteal +5%. Blood skills cost 15% less mana.;Sanguine Monarch|Killing a bleeding enemy restores 6% max HP and extends Blood Ward. Crimson Lance|Fire a lance of your own blood that heals you for a portion of damage dealt.;Blood Ward|Form a shield of coagulated blood that absorbs damage and empowers lifesteal.;Sanguine Domain|Turn the ground into a bleeding wound for 6s, draining enemies inside.
spatial Spatial Slash Distance is a courtesy. You may revoke it. The air cracks along invisible seams. You can feel the exact edge where one place ends and another begins. +10% Critical Chance. Blink and teleport skills deal +20% damage. Edge of Here|Rift Slash pierces +1 enemy and cuts 15% wider.;Unmoored|Dimension Step gains an extra charge. Critical hits reduce teleport cooldowns by 1s. Rift Slash|Cut a line through space. Everything on the line is struck at once.;Dimension Step|Slip behind the nearest enemy and deliver a spatial cut.;Collapsing Rift|Open a sucking wound in space that pulls enemies in and grinds them.
phantom Phantom Clone Which one of you is real? Your reflection peels itself from mirrors and shadows. Each copy insists it is the original. Summons gain +35% damage. +10% Dodge. Clones inherit 20% of your stats. Through the Mirror|Mirror Self creates an additional clone. Summons last 2s longer.;Army of One|Whenever you dodge, a phantom echo strikes your attacker. Mirror Self|Split off a phantom clone that fights beside you for 10s.;Veil Swap|Swap places with an enemy and stun it, leaving a phantom in your place.;Phantom Barrage|Your phantoms fire a fan of spectral blades in every direction.
soul Soul Absorption Nothing truly ends. It only changes owner. When living things die near you, something thin and bright leaks upward. You have learned to drink it. +6% Lifesteal. Killing enemies restores 8 Mana. +10% XP gained. Thin Veil|Soul Drain heals +20% more. Soul Nova gains +20% radius.;Hollow Feast|Each enemy killed grants a stacking +3% damage buff for 10s (max 10). Soul Drain|Anchor a tether of soul-light to an enemy, damaging and healing over 3s.;Soul Nova|Release gathered souls in a ring. Heal for each enemy struck.;Harvest|Reap enemies below 30% HP. Each kill grants a soul charge of power.
gravity Gravity Manipulation The earth is only a suggestion of weight. Dust rises around you. Rain hesitates. The world leans in when you ask it to. +12% Attack. Enemies you strike are pulled slightly toward you. +8% Defense. Dense Star|Gravity Well radius +25%. Your slams knock enemies down for 0.6s.;Event Horizon|Singularity damage +40% and leaves a lingering gravity scar. Gravity Well|Crush a point in space, pulling enemies in and slowing them.;Singularity|Collapse gravity at the target point. Heavy damage, brief stun.;Levitate|Defy the ground for 6s: +25% speed, +30% defense, and immunity to knockback.
necro Necromancy Death is a door that only opens one way. Unless you cheat. The dead whisper in a language older than graves. They offer to work for you, briefly. Summons gain +40% damage. Killing an enemy has a 25% chance to raise a brief skeleton. Bone Choir|Raise Dead summons two skeletons. Minions gain +20% HP.;Lord of the Quiet|Your summons explode into bone shards when they die. Raise Dead|Call a skeleton warrior from the ground to fight for 12s.;Corpse Burst|Detonate a corpse-like bloom of necrotic force at the target area.;Death Coil|Fire a screaming skull that damages enemies and heals you.
time Time Perception The present is a narrow room. You have found the door. Between one heartbeat and the next, you live an extra second. Nobody else notices. +12% Cooldown Recovery. +10% Attack Speed. +10% Dodge. Long Second|Temporal Bubble slows enemies 10% more and lasts 1s longer.;Closed Loop|Rewind heals 50% more and grants 1s of invulnerability. Temporal Bubble|Slow time in an area for 5s. Enemies inside move and attack sluggishly.;Haste|Accelerate your own timeline for 7s: +30% attack speed, +20% speed.;Rewind|Pull your body back to where it was three seconds ago and heal.
dragon Dragon Transformation There is a furnace under your ribs. It has always been there. Scales itch beneath your skin. Your shadow stretches wings you do not yet have. +10% Max HP. +12% Attack. Taking damage builds Dragon Fury, boosting damage. Scalebound|+12% Defense. Dragon Breath reaches 20% farther.;Sky Tyrant|Draconic Form also grants flight-like speed and a burning aura. Dragon Breath|Exhale a cone of searing flame that burns everything in front of you.;Wing Gale|Beat spectral wings, dashing forward and blasting enemies aside.;Draconic Form|Let the dragon surface for 10s: +40% attack, +20% HP, +15% speed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **ECLIPSE SYSTEM: THE LAST AWAKENED** as a playable browser-based 2D pixel-art action RPG, defaulting to Indonesian with an optional English setting that persists between sessions.

## Requirements
- Localize visible content into natural Indonesian by default across the interface, story, dialogue, missions, abilities, enemies, gear, items, dungeons, achievements, tutorials, combat information, stats, controls, and endings.
- Keep system messages mysterious, firm, and formal; translate Epic as **EPIS**; keep text legible and unclipped.
- Offer **Bahasa Indonesia (Default)** and **English (Opsional)**; persist the selection.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, features, stats, or balance.

## Decisions
- Retain procedural pixel-art assets and the existing browser implementation.
- Character creation includes starting-path selection.
- Legendary, Mythic, and Divine abilities are generated in `src/main.js`, not a dedicated data file.
- Localize displayed content at render time; preserve gameplay data and stable ability IDs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `showHelp()` syntax and `beginAwakening()` player assignment; improved touch detection and added a touch USE button.
- Browser-tested desktop flows and mobile Chrome controls, movement, and NPC dialogue.
- Added `src/i18n.js` translation helpers, language preference persistence, settings selector, and boot-time localization; set document language to `id`.
- Localized some awakening, HUD, system-tab, quest, equipment, level-up, evolution, day, enemy/boss-defeat, and toast messages.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `node --check src/i18n.js` passed after the latest localization edits.

### Active
- Expand Indonesian translations for ability names, taglines, descriptions, passives, skills, and evolutions in `src/data/abilities/low.js`, `src/data/abilities/mid.js`, and generated high-rarity abilities in `src/main.js`.
- Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`, including rarity and ability labels.
- Test both languages, preference persistence, text fit, and progression through NPC, boss, and loot flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add comprehensive ability-data translations, including generated high-rarity abilities, in `src/i18n.js`.
2. Localize remaining static and dynamic interface text in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
3. Run syntax and translation-coverage checks; browser-test Indonesian/English, persistence, legibility, and core progression.

## Relevant Files
- `src/i18n.js`: Translation dictionaries and language preference helpers; ability and interface coverage remains incomplete.
- `src/main.js`: Dynamic UI rendering and generated high-rarity ability data.
- `index.html`: Static interface text and accessibility labels.
- `src/data/abilities/low.js`: Common and Uncommon ability text.
- `src/data/abilities/mid.js`: Rare and EPIS ability text.
- `src/data/rarity.js`: Rarity labels and definitions.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layouts and text-fit styling.

## Important Context
- Local test server URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
- Ability-coverage checks found untranslated entries including `strength`, `regen`, and `nightvision`.
- Generated high-rarity names append `Transcendent` or `Ascendant`; generated evolution names and descriptions also need localization.
- `src/i18n.js` already includes translations for Solar Dominion, Void Sovereignty, and Worldstorm, including their taglines, descriptions, and skills.
- Remaining dynamic text includes `updatePreview()` constructing `PATH OF THE ...`, raw rarity names in `beginAwakening()`, raw ability names in the HUD title, and quest text assigned by `createMap()`.
- `main.js` has `localizeStatic()` for existing text nodes and attributes; dynamically created content needs explicit translation at render time.
